summary: netbox.netbox changed how slugs are generated, which matters if you relied on the old behavior.
questions: Why did netbox.netbox generate a different slug after upgrading?

answer_card.title: netbox.netbox slug generation changed
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 14.0.0, netbox.netbox changed the behavior for **generating slugs**. If your playbooks relied on the previous slug format, review them, or set slugs explicitly.
